title: A closed list of thinking operations
statement: Tag items against a closed, versioned list of thinking operations kept apart from format and knowledge labels, so each item is labelled by the work it demands.
detail: A Grade 5 reading project's taxonomy calibration found that, with knowledge labels admissible as operation tags, verdicts on whether an item's tag matched its work were ill-posed: an evidence item could classify to a format label for selecting evidence instead of the operation of telling supported from unsupported claims. An open vocabulary was rejected on that measurement, and a proposal declares a closed list of operations, versioned with the graph and open to challenge at review, with facts, schemas and format knowledge kept as knowledge rather than operations. It calls the list a design commitment, not a discovery, since reading comprehension has no natural set of operations.
against: The closed list is still a proposal (`grade3-reading/artifacts/semantic-judge-calibration-2026-07-10/kc-graph-change-proposal.md`, line 9), and in the same calibration a judge relabelled one honestly tagged evidence item to a neighbouring operation, which as a blocking gate would false-flag such items (`grade3-reading/artifacts/semantic-judge-calibration-2026-07-10/JUDGE-CALIBRATION-REPORT.md`, lines 81-84).

evidence.quote: Without a declared closed label set, tag-vs-work verdicts are ill-posed: with knowledge KCs admissible as labels, an evidence item can classify to the format KC `exam_hottext_select_evidence` instead of the cognitive op `disc_supported_vs_unsupported`.
rejected on measurement - ground 2 of the op-taxonomy NO-GO; tag-vs-work verdicts become ill-posed and evidence items classify to format KCs (exam_hottext_select_evidence) instead of cognitive work.

The closed operation vocabulary is a curriculum design commitment, not a discovery: ELA comprehension has no domain-intrinsic operation set, so this list is a choice this build makes, versioned with the graph (graph_version bump + rationale to change it) and challengeable at review.
As a blocking gate this behavior would false-flag honestly tagged evidence items.
